visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Large Fibonacci Numbers Overflow
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The 50th Fibonacci number is 12586269025, but the program prints a negative number.

solution.explanation: Fibonacci numbers grow quickly: after about 46 terms they no longer fit in an int. Java does not report the overflow; the value just wraps around into a negative number. A long holds values up to about 9 quintillion.
